gen-gf-anybody-rubik: Rubik keeps its soft, rounded lowercase looking large beside the capitals. Anybody is the louder one, with gently flared curve ends and a bold, show-off stance, while Rubik just gets on with being clear.
gen-gf-ar-one-sans-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and sturdy, with wide-mouthed curves. AR One Sans stays crisp above it, its c tips never creeping toward touching, and that clean-versus-warm split is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-arapey-fs-bespoke-sans: Arapey packs its letters into dense, touching strands, with heavy stems and faint scratch-like horizontals that feel literary. Bespoke Sans is the sharper, more spacious one, leaving generous room between curve ends and stems.
gen-gf-arbutus-slab-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified slab letters with a slight stretch. Arbutus Slab keeps a measured thick-thin ratio up top, while Bespoke Sans below it is a sharp sans-serif with generous space around every curve, so paragraphs would move along smoothly.
gen-gf-aref-ruqaa-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, leaving generous space between its curve ends and stems. And Aref Ruqaa, with hairlines only somewhat lighter than its stems, gives that precision an editorial, classic voice above it.
gen-gf-aref-ruqaa-ink-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, with generous space between curve ends and stems. Bespoke Sans can take a slightly larger size without losing that crispness, while Aref Ruqaa Ink leads with thick, subdued strokes.
gen-gf-artifika-fs-bespoke-sans: Traditional, a bit bookish, and loosely tracked. Artifika has a slight tug of heavier verticals, and Bespoke Sans follows with sharp, spacious curves that would keep a long page of text feeling clear and light.
gen-gf-arya-fs-literata: Approachable from the first line. Arya keeps its stroke modulation tempered, and Literata follows with sturdy thin lines and wide-mouthed curves, giving the page a bookish warmth under that friendly heading.
gen-gf-asar-fs-bespoke-sans: Authoritative but never stark. Asar has thick and thin strokes close enough to feel related, and Bespoke Sans sits beneath it as a plain sans, sharp and open, letting that dignified heading lead.
gen-gf-assistant-fs-literata: Literata feels sophisticated and bookish, with sturdy thin strokes and restrained thick ones. Over a long page its wide-mouthed curves would stay comfortable, while Assistant above it opens a wide channel into every bowl.
